activity_overrides.reason: Fritigern's reviewed 376–380 Tervingi activity covers the Lower Danube crossing into Roman Moesia/Thrace and the 378 victory at Adrianople. An Activity-level Balkan anchor closes this mobile migration-war interval without assigning the Tervingi a misleading permanent static leaf.
source_refs: Oxford Classical Dictionary: Fritigern — leader of the Tervingi from c.376 to c.380, pursued asylum inside the Roman Empire and won at Adrianople in 378
